title: Index freshness treadmill after receipt commits
summary: Committing index-publication receipts advances git HEAD past L:/Supabase SHA; repeated index:publish after each commit is a loop, not a blocker for OPERATIONAL harvest.
retrievalQuestions: What is the index freshness treadmill after operational publish?
Should I keep running index:publish after OPERATIONAL receipt exists?
How do I explain freshness FAIL when harvest is already OPERATIONAL?

futureAgentInstructions.whenThisAppears: Operator says stop or freshness FAIL after OPERATIONAL receipt exists
doNot: Loop index:publish after every receipt commit
Treat freshness DRIFT as failed operational publish when OPERATIONAL receipt exists
proveBeforeClaiming: Explain git HEAD vs L: SHA delta separately from harvest status
